name: SocialListeningAPI
description:
SocialListeningAPI lets Claude search public posts on LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Facebook, Hacker News, TikTok, and YouTube.
Search Reddit comments and Google results, discover Instagram users, hashtags, and places, and retrieve selected public profiles, posts, threads, replies, and comments.
Results use a normalized response structure and include source URLs when available. Successful searches use workspace credits, failed requests use none.
Coverage may be incomplete when source platforms change.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SocialListeningAPI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SocialListeningAPI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sociallisteningapi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SocialListeningAPI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SocialListeningAPI provides these MCP tools: get_instagram_profile, get_linkedin_user_posts, get_reddit_post_comments, get_supported_sources, get_x_tweet_replies, get_x_tweet_thread, get_x_user, get_x_user_posts, search_google_results, search_instagram, search_reddit_comments, and search_social_posts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SocialListeningAPI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SocialListeningAPI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SocialListeningAPI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SocialListeningAPI is developed by SocialListeningAPI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
